source.std_document: PPRA Standard Tender Document for Procurement of Information Technology

sections.title: Tender Documents and Addenda
sections.bidder_instructions: Review and acknowledge the published tender documents and any addenda before completing other sections.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD — Instructions to Tenderers; Tender Documents

sections.title: Lots and Alternatives
sections.bidder_instructions: Select the lot(s) and alternative (if permitted) that apply to this tender.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD — Instructions to Tenderers; TDS lot and alternative provisions

sections.title: Confidential Business Questionnaire
sections.bidder_instructions: Complete one Confidential Business Questionnaire for the bidder and each required JV entity. Verified identity is read-only; use your account profile for corrections. Certification is deliberate and entity-scoped.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Section IV — Confidential Business Questionnaire

bidder_owned_fields.label: Interest or relationship with procuring entity

sections.title: Statutory Declarations
sections.bidder_instructions: Review the four statutory declaration records, answer how this tender was prepared, disclose any competitor interactions if required, and certify the declaration bundle. Certification creates four separate legal records; saving a draft does not certify.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Section IV — Tendering Forms (statutory declarations)

summary_statements.sd1: The Tenderer, its directors and subcontractors have not been debarred from participating in public procurement proceedings.
summary_statements.sd2: The Tenderer, its agents and subcontractors have not and will not engage in corruption, fraud, inducement or collusion in this tender.
summary_statements.code_of_ethics: The Tenderer has read and understood the applicable procurement legislation and Code of Ethics and commits to comply with them.

legal_records.title: Certificate of Independent Tender Determination
SD1 - Self-Declaration that the Tenderer is Not Debarred
legal_records.body:
SELF-DECLARATION THAT THE PERSON/TENDERER IS NOT DEBARRED IN THE MATTER OF THE PUBLIC PROCUREMENT AND ASSET DISPOSAL ACT 2015

I, {declarant_name} of {declarant_postal_address}, being a resident of {declarant_place_of_residence} in {declarant_country_of_residence}, do hereby make a statement as follows:-

1. THAT I am the {declarant_title} of {tenderer_name}, the Tenderer in respect of Tender No. {tender_reference} for {tender_title} to {procuring_entity_name}.
2. THAT the Tenderer, its directors and subcontractors have not been debarred from participating in public procurement proceedings.
3. THAT what is deponed to hereinabove is true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief.

Certified at: {certified_at}

legal_records.title: SD2 - Self-Declaration that the Tenderer will not engage in Corruption or Fraud
legal_records.body:
SELF-DECLARATION THAT THE PERSON/TENDERER WILL NOT ENGAGE IN ANY CORRUPT OR FRAUDULENT PRACTICE

I, {declarant_name} of {declarant_postal_address}, being a resident of {declarant_place_of_residence} in {declarant_country_of_residence}, do hereby make a statement as follows:-

1. THAT I am the {declarant_title} of {tenderer_name}, the Tenderer in respect of Tender No. {tender_reference} for {tender_title} to {procuring_entity_name}.
2. THAT the Tenderer, its agents and subcontractors have not and will not engage in any corrupt or fraudulent practice, inducement or collusive practice in connection with this tender.
3. THAT what is deponed to hereinabove is true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief.

Certified at: {certified_at}

legal_records.title: Code of Ethics Declaration

sections.title: Tender Security
sections.bidder_instructions: Provide the required tender security or tender-securing declaration as configured for this tender.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD — Tender Security / Tender-Securing Declaration; TDS

sections.title: Preliminary Requirements and Evidence
sections.bidder_instructions: Upload or declare evidence for preliminary examination requirements.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Section III — Evaluation and Qualification Criteria (Preliminary)

sections.title: Qualification and Capability
sections.bidder_instructions: Respond to qualification and capability criteria with supporting evidence.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Section III — Qualification Criteria

sections.title: Technical Proposal and Implementation Plan
sections.bidder_instructions: Provide the technical proposal and implementation plan required by the tender.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Section IV / Part 2 — Technical proposal obligations

sections.title: Requirements Compliance
sections.bidder_instructions: Respond to each published IT requirement with compliance status and evidence where required.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Part 2 — Requirements; Section VIII schedule where applicable

sections.title: Price Schedule
sections.bidder_instructions: Complete the electronic price schedule including any discounts. Totals and discount declarations flow read-only into the Form of Tender.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD — Price Schedule forms

sections.title: Form of Tender
sections.bidder_instructions: Review the material terms of your offer drawn from completed bid sections, complete the commissions disclosure, and certify the Form of Tender. Certification creates the legal record; saving a draft does not certify.
source_refs: PPRA IT STD Section IV — Form of Tender (pages 35–37)

sections.slice_completion_rule: Complete when all required bidder-owned fields and applicable declarations validate. Authorized confirmation and cross-section associated-form blockers are deferred; associated-form cards are informational until those sections exist. Save ≠ confirm/submit.
